description: Default payer mix for a typical Critical Access Hospital
source: Medicare Payment Advisory Commission (MedPAC) / Flex Monitoring Team

medicare.label: Medicare (Parts A & B)
medicare.notes: Includes Medicare Advantage; CAHs receive cost-based reimbursement for traditional Medicare

medicaid.label: Medicaid
medicaid.notes: Varies significantly by state Medicaid expansion status; range 0.08–0.30

commercial.label: Commercial / Private Insurance
commercial.notes: Includes employer-sponsored and individual marketplace plans

self_pay.label: Self-Pay / Uninsured
self_pay.notes: Includes patients with no insurance and those paying out of pocket; often results in bad debt

other_government.label: Other Government Programs
other_government.notes: TRICARE, VA, Indian Health Service, workers compensation, and other government payers
